Question 2 (a seat naming the job it is held for), Jack Heart (2026-11-12): "selfplay should be allowed, metrics besides winning could be considered, or it could be aco-op game". So a relative seat that resolves to the held checkpoint itself, or to another checkpoint of its own job, is played like any other seat: never skipped, never refused. An author who wants a seating only for some jobs holds its benchmark only for those jobs' checkpoints. Remove the "plays nothing" rule and its docs.
